score_components.authority_score: source authority weight multiplied by explicit federal source class
score_components.federal_relevance_score: explicit relevance to agency, program, advisory, enforcement, grant, contract, or risk signal
score_components.grant_signal_score: explicit grant or funding opportunity evidence
score_components.procurement_signal_score: explicit contract, award, solicitation, or recipient evidence
score_components.risk_signal_score: explicit advisory, enforcement, crime, threat, or corridor signal evidence
score_components.freshness_score: retrieval and source publication freshness where explicit
